tool_input.description: Research parent hierarchy in test fixtures
tool_input.prompt:
I need to understand the parent hierarchies in the semio test fixtures. Please find and report the parent relationships for types and designs in the test kit JSON files.

Search for "parent" in these files:
- semio/assets/semio/metabolism.kit.semio.json (or similar naming)
- semio/assets/semio/nakagin-capsule-tower.kit.semio.json (or similar)
- semio/assets/semio/metabolism.shallow.kit.semio.json
- semio/assets/semio/nakagin-capsule-tower.filtered.kit.semio.json
- semio/assets/semio/metabolism.kit.diff.semio.json

For each file with parent references, tell me:
1. The type or design name that has a parent
2. The parent's guid it references
3. Try to find the parent type/design name by matching the guid

Also find the main kit files (not diff/shallow/filtered variants) to understand the full hierarchy chain.

Also look at the file listing in semio/assets/semio/ to find the right filenames.

Be thorough - read the entire types and designs arrays from the kit files to trace the hierarchies.
